title: What is happening on the deal right now
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender o Present Continuous para descrever ações que estão acontecendo agora no processo comercial. Isso é útil para dar status de propostas, cotações e follow-ups em tempo real a clientes de siderurgia, mineração e cimento, e para dizer ao seu gerente o que você está fazendo neste momento.
intro: In the sales team at Delta Ducon, things move fast. A client from a steel plant calls and asks about a proposal, and you need to say what is happening now.
Today we practise the Present Continuous. We use it for actions happening at this moment: I am preparing the quote, we are waiting for the client, they are reviewing the proposal.
introAudio: Hello. Right now I am preparing a quote for a mining client. My colleague is calling the customer, and our engineers are reviewing the technical scope. Let us learn how to talk about what is happening now.
vocab: I am preparing the quote for the cement plant today.
We are sending the proposal this afternoon.
The client is reviewing our offer now.
I am doing a follow-up with the steel customer.
We are working hard because the deadline is close.
The manager is leading the negotiation right now.
practice: I am finishing the ______ for the mining company.
We are sending the ______ to the client this week.
The ______ from the steel plant is calling now.
I am doing a ______ email after the meeting.
We are hurrying because the ______ is tomorrow.
My manager is leading the price ______ right now.
She is preparing a new ______ for the chemical plant.
They are reading the ______ at this moment.

audio.title: A busy day in sales
audio.text: Right now the sales team is very busy. I am preparing a quote for a steel client, and Ana is writing a proposal for a cement plant. Our engineers are checking the technical scope at this moment. The client is waiting for our answer, so we are working fast. My manager is calling the customer to confirm the deadline.

readAloud: I am preparing the quote right now.
We are sending the proposal today.
The client is reviewing our offer.
My manager is leading the negotiation.
They are waiting for our answer.
fill: I ___ calling the customer right now.
qa: What are you doing right now?
I am preparing a quote for a client.
Who is calling the customer?
My manager is calling the customer.
Are you sending the proposal today?
Yes, I am sending it this afternoon.
What is the client doing?
The client is reviewing our proposal.
Why are you working fast?
I am working fast because the deadline is close.
sentences: I am preparing the quote now.
We are sending the proposal today.
The client is reviewing our offer.
My manager is leading the negotiation.
They are waiting for our answer.
She is writing the follow-up email.
I am calling the customer right now.
The engineers are checking the scope.
grammarPoint: Present Continuous = am / is / are + verbo-ing. Usamos para ações que acontecem agora. I am preparing the quote. — Eu estou preparando a cotação. The client is reviewing the proposal. — O cliente está revisando a proposta.
deepDive: Escolha o verbo to be certo: I am, he/she/it is, we/you/they are. Depois acrescente o verbo principal com -ing. Dica: palavras como now e right now são um bom sinal de que você precisa do Present Continuous.
examples: I am preparing the quote.
Eu estou preparando a cotação.
We are sending the proposal.
Nós estamos enviando a proposta.
The client is reviewing our offer.
O cliente está revisando nossa oferta.
They are waiting for a reply.
Eles estão esperando uma resposta.
She is calling the customer.
Ela está ligando para o cliente.
My manager is leading the negotiation.
Meu gerente está conduzindo a negociação.
He is checking the deadline.
Ele está verificando o prazo.
We are visiting a steel plant today.
Nós estamos visitando uma usina siderúrgica hoje.
I am writing a follow-up email.
Eu estou escrevendo um e-mail de acompanhamento.
The engineers are studying the scope.
Os engenheiros estão estudando o escopo.
mistakes: Não esqueça o verbo to be (am).
Depois de is use o verbo com -ing.
Com we use are, não is.
I am call the customer now.
I am calling the customer now.

celebrate.en: Well done. You can now describe your work as it happens — a key skill for keeping clients informed and confident.
celebrate.pt: Muito bem. Agora você consegue descrever seu trabalho enquanto ele acontece — uma habilidade essencial para manter clientes informados e confiantes.

title: Routines and what is happening now
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a diferença entre Present Simple (rotinas e fatos) e Present Continuous (ações agora). Isso ajuda você a explicar a clientes de mineração e química como a Delta normalmente trabalha e, ao mesmo tempo, o que está acontecendo neste momento numa proposta ou negociação.
intro: In sales you talk about two kinds of things. What you usually do: we quote projects, we visit clients, we send proposals. And what is happening now: I am preparing a quote, the client is waiting.
Today we compare Present Simple and Present Continuous. Choosing the right one makes your message clear to every customer.
introAudio: We usually send a proposal within five days. But right now I am preparing a special quote for a mining client, because the deadline is very close. Today we learn when to use each form.
vocab: We usually visit the client before the quote.
We always answer the client fast.
Today I am visiting a cement plant.
The customer often asks for a discount.
We send a written offer every week.
I am joining a sales meeting right now.
practice: We ______ visit the client before the quote.
______ I am visiting a cement plant.
The ______ often asks for a lower price.
We send a written ______ every week.
I am joining a sales ______ right now.
We ______ prepare a quote after the visit.
______ the team is finishing a big proposal.

audio.title: How we work, and what we do now
audio.text: At Delta Ducon we usually follow a clear process. First we visit the client, then we send a proposal. We always answer questions fast. But today is special: right now I am preparing an urgent quote for a steel plant, and my manager is negotiating the price. We normally take five days, but this week we are working faster.

readAloud: We usually send a proposal in five days.
Right now I am preparing an urgent quote.
The customer always asks for a discount.
Today we are visiting a mining client.
We always answer emails fast.
fill: We ___ send a proposal every week (usual routine).
Right now I ___ preparing a quote.
The customer always ___ for a discount (ask).
Today the team ___ visiting a client.
We usually ___ the client before the quote (visit).
At the moment we ___ working faster than usual.
qa: What do you usually do first?
We usually visit the client first.
What are you doing right now?
Right now I am preparing a quote.
How often do you send proposals?
We send proposals every week.
What is your manager doing today?
Today my manager is negotiating a price.
Do customers often ask for a discount?
Yes, customers often ask for a discount.
sentences: We usually send a proposal in five days.
Right now I am preparing an urgent quote.
The customer always asks for a discount.
Today we are visiting a mining client.
We always answer emails fast.
This week we are working faster than usual.
She writes the offer every Monday.
At the moment my manager is negotiating the price.
grammarPoint: Present Simple = rotinas e fatos (I send, she sends). Present Continuous = agora (I am sending). We usually send a proposal in five days. — Nós geralmente enviamos uma proposta em cinco dias. Right now I am preparing a quote. — Agora eu estou preparando uma cotação.
deepDive: Palavras como usually, always e every week pedem Present Simple. Palavras como now, right now e today (em curso) pedem Present Continuous. No Present Simple, lembre do -s com he/she/it: she sends, the customer asks.
examples: We usually visit the client first.
Nós geralmente visitamos o cliente primeiro.
Right now I am preparing a quote.
Agora eu estou preparando uma cotação.
She writes the offer every Monday.
Ela escreve a oferta toda segunda-feira.
Today we are visiting a mining plant.
Hoje nós estamos visitando uma mineradora.
The customer always asks for a discount.
O cliente sempre pede desconto.
This week we are working faster.
Esta semana nós estamos trabalhando mais rápido.
We send proposals every week.
Nós enviamos propostas toda semana.
My manager is negotiating the price now.
Meu gerente está negociando o preço agora.
I check my email every morning.
Eu verifico meu e-mail toda manhã.
At the moment the client is reviewing our offer.
No momento o cliente está revisando nossa oferta.
mistakes: I am usually visit the client.
Rotina é Present Simple, sem am.
Right now I prepare a quote.
Right now I am preparing a quote.
She write the offer every week.
She writes the offer every week.
We are send proposals every week.
Today I visit a client (in progress).
Today I am visiting a client.
Ação em curso hoje pede Continuous.
quick: Right now I ___ preparing a quote.
The customer always ___ for a discount (ask).

celebrate.en: Excellent work. Knowing when to use each tense lets you sound clear and professional with every client.
celebrate.pt: Excelente trabalho. Saber quando usar cada tempo verbal deixa você claro e profissional com cada cliente.

title: How much and how many in a quote
grammar: some / any, much / many, countable and uncountable nouns
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a usar some, any, much e many com substantivos contáveis e incontáveis. Isso é essencial para falar de quantidades numa cotação: quantas unidades, quanto equipamento, se há alguma dúvida ou algum desconto para clientes de cimento, química e siderurgia.
intro: In a quote you talk about quantities all the time. How many filters? How much equipment? Do we have any discounts? Is there some flexibility on the price?
Today we learn some and any, much and many, and the difference between countable and uncountable nouns. This helps you write clear and correct offers.
introAudio: In every quote I count things. How many units does the client need? How much equipment fits the budget? Do we have any special discounts? Let us learn to talk about quantities.
vocab: We have some discounts for large orders.
Do you have any questions about the quote?
How much equipment does the plant need?
How many filters are in the proposal?
The equipment for gas cleaning is expensive.
practice: We have ______ discounts for large orders.
Do you have ______ questions about the quote?
How ______ equipment does the plant need?
How ______ filters are in the proposal?
The ______ for gas cleaning is expensive.
There are ______ new items in this offer.
We do not have ______ stock right now.

audio.title: Talking about quantities
audio.text: When I write a quote, I always check the numbers. How many units does the client want? How much equipment fits the space? We usually have some standard discounts, but we do not have any special price without approval. If the customer has any questions, I answer them fast. There is not much time before the deadline, so I count every item with care.

readAloud: We have some discounts for large orders.
Do you have any questions about the quote?
How much equipment does the plant need?
How many filters are in the proposal?
There is not much time before the deadline.
fill: We have ___ discounts for large orders.
How ___ equipment does the plant need?
How ___ filters are in the proposal?
There is not ___ time before the deadline.
We do not have ___ stock right now.
There are ___ new items in this offer.
How ___ units did the client order?
qa: How many units does the client need?
The client needs ten units.
Do you have any questions about the quote?
No, I do not have any questions.
How much equipment fits the budget?
Not much equipment fits this budget.
Are there any discounts?
Yes, there are some discounts for large orders.
How many filters are in the proposal?
There are twelve filters in the proposal.
sentences: We have some discounts for large orders.
Do you have any questions about the quote?
How much equipment does the plant need?
How many filters are in the proposal?
There is not much time before the deadline.
We do not have any special price without approval.
There are some new items in this offer.
How many units did the client order?
grammarPoint: some = frases afirmativas; any = perguntas e negativas. much = incontáveis (equipment, time), many = contáveis (units, filters). How many units? — Quantas unidades? How much equipment? — Quanto equipamento?
deepDive: Substantivos contáveis têm plural e usam many: filters, units, questions. Incontáveis não têm plural e usam much: equipment, time, water, money. Use some em ofertas (we have some discounts) e any em perguntas ou negativas (do you have any questions).
examples: We have some discounts.
Nós temos alguns descontos.
Do you have any questions?
Você tem alguma pergunta?
How much equipment do you need?
Quanto equipamento você precisa?
How many filters are there?
Quantos filtros há?
There is not much time.
Não há muito tempo.
We do not have any stock.
Nós não temos estoque nenhum.
There are some new items.
Há alguns itens novos.
The client ordered many units.
O cliente pediu muitas unidades.
We do not have much budget.
Nós não temos muito orçamento.
Are there any special conditions?
Há alguma condição especial?
mistakes: How many equipment do you need?
How much equipment do you need?
We do not have some stock.
We do not have any stock.

celebrate.en: Great job. Talking clearly about quantities keeps your quotes accurate and your clients confident.
celebrate.pt: Ótimo trabalho. Falar claramente sobre quantidades mantém suas cotações precisas e seus clientes confiantes.

title: Comparing offers and solutions
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender os comparativos (adjetivo + -er ou more ... than) para comparar propostas, preços e soluções. Isso é útil para mostrar a clientes de siderurgia e mineração por que uma solução da Delta é melhor, mais barata, mais rápida ou mais eficiente do que outra opção.
intro: In sales you often compare things. This solution is cheaper than that one. Our system is more efficient than the old one. This proposal is faster to install.
Today we learn comparatives. They help you show the value of a Delta solution against another option, clearly and honestly.
introAudio: Our new gas cleaning system is more efficient than the old one, and the installation is faster. In this lesson we learn how to compare two options and show the client the better choice.
vocab: Our solution is cheaper than the competitor's.
This system is faster to install.
Our service is better than before.
The new filter is more efficient than the old one.
This material is stronger than steel.
Our price is lower than the market price.
practice: Our solution is ______ than the competitor's.
This system is ______ to install than the old one.
The new filter is ______ than the old one.
This material is ______ than standard steel.
Our price is lower ______ the market price.
The turbo model is ______ than the basic model.
This proposal is ______ than last year's.

audio.title: Why our solution is better
audio.text: Let me compare the two options for you. Our new system is more efficient than the current one, and it is cheaper to run. The installation is faster, so the plant stops for less time. The equipment is stronger and lasts longer than the standard model. In short, our solution is better than the alternative, and the total cost is lower than you expect.

readAloud: Our solution is cheaper than the competitor's.
This system is faster to install.
Our service is better than before.
The new filter is more efficient than the old one.
This material is stronger than standard steel.
fill: Our solution is ___ than the competitor's (cheap).
The new filter is more ___ than the old one (efficient).
Our price is lower ___ the market price.
The turbo model is ___ than the basic one (fast).
This offer is ___ than last year's (cheap).
qa: Is your solution cheaper than the competitor's?
Yes, our solution is cheaper than theirs.
Why is this system better?
It is more efficient and faster to install.
Which model is stronger?
The industrial model is stronger than the basic one.
Is the installation faster?
Yes, the installation is faster than usual.
Is this proposal more efficient?
Yes, it is more efficient than the old design.
sentences: Our solution is cheaper than the competitor's.
This system is faster to install.
Our service is better than before.
The new filter is more efficient than the old one.
This material is stronger than standard steel.
The total cost is lower than you expect.
The turbo model is faster than the basic model.
This proposal is cheaper than last year's.
grammarPoint: Comparativos: adjetivos curtos + -er + than (cheaper, faster, stronger). Adjetivos longos: more + adjetivo + than (more efficient than). Irregular: good → better. Our system is faster than the old one. — Nosso sistema é mais rápido que o antigo.
deepDive: Use -er com adjetivos de uma sílaba (cheap → cheaper, fast → faster). Com adjetivos longos use more (efficient → more efficient). Guarde as formas irregulares: good → better, bad → worse. Depois da comparação, quase sempre vem than.
examples: Our solution is cheaper than theirs.
Nossa solução é mais barata que a deles.
This system is faster than the old one.
Este sistema é mais rápido que o antigo.
The new filter is more efficient.
O novo filtro é mais eficiente.
Our service is better than before.
Nosso serviço é melhor que antes.
This material is stronger than steel.
Este material é mais forte que o aço.
The total cost is lower than expected.
O custo total é menor que o esperado.
The turbo model is faster than the basic one.
O modelo turbo é mais rápido que o básico.
This proposal is cheaper than last year's.
Esta proposta é mais barata que a do ano passado.
The installation is easier than before.
A instalação é mais fácil que antes.
Their price is higher than ours.
O preço deles é mais alto que o nosso.
mistakes: Our solution is more cheap than theirs.
Our solution is cheaper than theirs.
Cheap é curto: use cheaper, não more cheap.
Efficient é longo: use more efficient.
Our service is gooder than before.
Our service is better than before.
This is faster that the old one.
This is faster than the old one.
Use than, não that, para comparar.
Não use more com um adjetivo que já tem -er.
quick: This system is ___ than the old one (fast).

celebrate.en: Well done. Comparing options clearly is how you help a client choose the right solution with confidence.
celebrate.pt: Muito bem. Comparar opções com clareza é como você ajuda o cliente a escolher a solução certa com confiança.

title: Presenting the best solution
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender os superlativos (the -est ou the most) para destacar o melhor de tudo. Isso é útil para apresentar a clientes de cimento, química e mineração a solução mais eficiente, o sistema mais confiável ou a proposta com o melhor custo-benefício da Delta.
intro: When you present a solution, you want to show the best of it. This is our most efficient system. It is the strongest material on the market. We offer the fastest installation.
Today we learn superlatives. They help you highlight what makes a Delta solution stand out among all the options.
introAudio: This is our most efficient gas cleaning system. It offers the best performance and the fastest installation on the market. In this lesson we learn how to present the very best of a solution.
vocab: This is the best solution for your plant.
This is the cheapest option in the range.
We offer the fastest installation on the market.
This is the most efficient filter we produce.
This is the strongest material we use.
It is the most reliable system in the industry.
practice: This is ______ solution for your plant.
This is ______ option in the whole range.
We offer ______ installation on the market.
It is ______ system in the industry.
This model gives you ______ performance overall.
Our design is ______ way to clean the gas.

audio.title: The best choice for your plant
audio.text: Let me present our top solution. This is the most efficient gas cleaning system we produce, and it is the most reliable one in the industry. It uses the strongest materials, so it lasts the longest. We also offer the fastest installation on the market. For your budget, this is the best choice and the cheapest to run over time.

readAloud: This is the best solution for your plant.
It is the most efficient system we produce.
We offer the fastest installation on the market.
This is the strongest material we use.
It is the most reliable system in the industry.
fill: This is the ___ solution for your plant (good).
This is the ___ option in the range (cheap).
This is the most ___ filter we make (efficient).
This is the ___ material we use (strong).
It is the most ___ system in the industry (reliable).
This is the ___ price we can offer (low).
qa: Which is your best solution?
This is the best solution for your needs.
What is the most efficient option?
This filter is the most efficient option.
Which system is the most reliable?
The industrial system is the most reliable.
What is the cheapest choice?
The standard model is the cheapest choice.
Which installation is the fastest?
The modular installation is the fastest.
sentences: This is the best solution for your plant.
It is the most efficient system we produce.
We offer the fastest installation on the market.
This is the strongest material we use.
It is the most reliable system in the industry.
This model lasts the longest.
This is the cheapest option to run over time.
We give you the lowest price we can.
grammarPoint: Superlativos: adjetivos curtos → the + adjetivo + -est (the fastest, the strongest). Adjetivos longos → the most + adjetivo (the most efficient). Irregular: good → the best. This is the most efficient system. — Este é o sistema mais eficiente.
deepDive: Use -est com adjetivos curtos (cheap → the cheapest, fast → the fastest) e sempre com the na frente. Com adjetivos longos use the most (reliable → the most reliable). Formas irregulares: good → the best, bad → the worst.
examples: This is the best solution.
Esta é a melhor solução.
It is the most efficient system.
É o sistema mais eficiente.
We offer the fastest installation.
Nós oferecemos a instalação mais rápida.
This is the strongest material.
Este é o material mais resistente.
It is the most reliable system.
É o sistema mais confiável.
This model lasts the longest.
Este modelo dura mais tempo.
This is the cheapest option.
Esta é a opção mais barata.
We give you the lowest price.
Nós damos a você o menor preço.
This is the largest plant we serve.
Esta é a maior planta que atendemos.
It is the most modern design available.
É o design mais moderno disponível.
mistakes: This is the most efficient system.
This is the most efficient filter.
Efficient é longo: the most efficient.
This is the most fast installation.
Fast é curto: the fastest, não the most fast.
Não esqueça o the antes do superlativo.
quick: This is the ___ price we can offer (low).

celebrate.en: Outstanding. You can now present the very best of a Delta solution and help clients choose with total confidence.
celebrate.pt: Excelente. Agora você consegue apresentar o melhor de uma solução da Delta e ajudar os clientes a escolher com total confiança.
